audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 matches the 48.97% win rate over 535 games, and both layers already agree on Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Locke/Locke/Skill. No chart change.

audit.whatIsWrong: The lane's whole timing hinges on Across the Veil being down and no text gave its cooldown; spikes[3] invented 'W charges'.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s against Ashen Pursuit's flat 10s — you get two step-ups per hop, and it is not a charged ability. Between Worlds is 140/120/100s, longer than Purgatory's 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: 22s (and 18s at max) stated in early, spikes[0], spikes[3], mid and whys[1]; the charge claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated — Purgatory carries grounding, which denies both the Across the Veil leap and the Between Worlds side-to-side teleport. Also: 'her W is her only escape' ignores The Weirding's backward hop, ability names were wrong ('Q Twofold', 'P Silver Stake', 'Ritual Nails'), and her passive healing was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: E The Weirding damages, slows and hops her backward, so she has a second out. Her passive exorcises spirits that follow and heal her, which makes Grievous Wounds live in this lane. Locke's Q is Soul Nails and his passive is unnamed in the kit file.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated as the answer to both her leap and her R teleport; The Weirding named as her second out; passive healing flagged for anti-heal; real names used.

edits.before: Aurora pokes with Q Twofold and W Across the Veil to reposition; respect her W dash-through spirits and use E Ashen Pursuit to close when her W is down, trading with P Silver Stake on-hits.
edits.after: Aurora pokes with Q Twofold Hex and hops with W Across the Veil, 22s at rank 1; step up in that window, and her only other out is E The Weirding's backward hop, which costs her the slow.

edits.before: Her R Between Worlds zones a big area, but your R Purgatory totem executes her mid-combo before she can W out — this is your cleanest kill window.
edits.after: Her R Between Worlds zones a big area, but Purgatory grounds — drop it on her and both the W leap and the R side-to-side teleport die. Cleanest kill window.

edits.before: With her first item her spirit-detonation burst can chunk you, but you match her as an assassin and your E reset keeps you slippery in the trade.
edits.after: With her first item her burst can chunk you, but the spirits she exorcises follow and heal her — bring Grievous Wounds, and your E reset keeps you slippery.

edits.before: Both are bursty mages/assassins; whoever lands their combo first wins. Track her W charges and answer her engage with your own all-in.
edits.after: Both are bursty; whoever lands their combo first wins. Her W is still 18s at max rank, so answer her engage with yours the moment she spends it.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are even: Aurora's Q pokes but her W is her only escape, so when it's on cooldown you can walk her down with Ritual Nails autos and force a bad trade.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are even: Aurora's Q pokes but her W hop is 22s at rank 1, so while it is down you can walk her down with Soul Nails marks and force a bad trade.

edits.before: Through 3-6 it stays skill-based — she wants spirit poke and W repositioning while you use E Ashen Pursuit to punish her dash timing; whoever manages cooldowns cleaner takes the exchange.
edits.after: Through 3-6 it stays skill-based — she wants Twofold Hex poke and W repositioning while your E Ashen Pursuit, flat 10s against her 22s hop, punishes the gap; cooldowns decide the exchange.

edits.before: After items it's a bursty coinflip, but at Level 6 your R Purgatory execute lands before her W Across the Veil pulls her to safety, giving you the one clear edge in an otherwise even lane.
edits.after: After items it's a bursty coinflip, but Purgatory grounds her — drop it under her feet and Across the Veil cannot carry her out, which is the one clear edge you own in an even lane.

edits.before: Level 2 stays skill as her W is her only real out.
edits.after: Level 2 stays skill — her W hop is a 22s escape.

edits.before: Locke favoured — R Purgatory executes before her W escape.
edits.after: Locke favoured — Purgatory grounds her W hop, then executes.

edits.before: Land R Purgatory to execute before she dashes out
edits.after: Land R Purgatory to ground her hop, then execute

edits.before: Poke with Q Twofold and build spirit stacks
edits.after: Poke with Q Twofold Hex and heal off spirits

notes: Twofold Hex recasts to drag active curses back toward Aurora, damaging anyone in the path — that recast is her real damage and is worth a line in the full layer's Key Ability Interactions, which currently only tracks her W. 'Silver Stake' is not a name in Locke's kit file and was not reused. Whether Purgatory's grounding blocks the Between Worlds internal teleport specifically is inferred from the dash flag on that ability, not stated by Riot.
